text:
rachel: FYI support case #INC-5510 from NovaMetrics - p95/p99 regressed on `chat-complete` route using redwood-compact-v3. p95 ~480ms -> 900ms, p99 ~1.6s starting 2026-04-01T09:11Z. customers seeing timeouts on some long-answer queries.

tom: oncall ack. which tenant and traffic shape?

rachel: tenant novam-prod, route `chat-complete`. steady traffic ~60r/s, spike bursts occasionally. lots of long responses (avg output tokens ~400). model pinned to redwood-compact-v3.

ops-bot: alert: route_latency.p99{route:chat-complete,model:redwood-compact-v3,region:us-central-1} = 1620ms at 2026-04-01T09:13:04Z :rotating_light:

ivy: pulling dashboards. p50 flat ~210ms, p95 jump to 900ms. node-level histograms show increased counts in high-leq buckets. queue_depth metric on several serve nodes up.

lucas: any deploys around 09:05-09:10Z? kernel or scheduler?

tom: checking deploys: `scheduler-v2.4.1` rolled to us-central-1 at 09:02Z (stage->prod). change notes: "adaptive-batching: prioritize throughput under observed seq_len distributions."

emma: Nova attached a repro curl that times out for them reliably. Repro snippet:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-compact-v3","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<long question>"}],"max_tokens":512,"stream":false,"timeout_ms":3000}'
```

ivy: I reproduced against us-central-1 gateway: p99 ~1.58s, p50 ~200ms. stack traces show blocking on `batch_wait_time` in runtime.

ops-bot: metric: runtime.batch_window_ms{node:serve-21} increased to 18ms after scheduler change (was 8ms). queue_depth{node:serve-21} peaked 1->14 at 09:07Z.

lucas: root cause likely the scheduler's adaptive-batching heuristics increasing window to wait for more tokens; that helps throughput but increases tail for long-response flows.

tom: mitigation plan (quick): 1) canary reduce `batch-window-ms` for redwood-compact-v3 on chat-complete in us-central-1 from 18->6 2) enable route fallback to redwood-small-v2 for non-CRT tenants 3) set per-tenant concurrency soft-limit for novam-prod 4) if rollback required, revert scheduler-v2.4.1 in region.

emma: command list: `ri-opsctl runtime set-config --model redwood-compact-v3 --route chat-complete --batch-window-ms 6 --region us-central-1` and `ri-opsctl route update chat-complete --fallback-model redwood-small-v2 --fallback-threshold-p99 1000 --fallback-window-s 45` and `ri-opsctl tenant update novam-prod --concurrency 12`

ops-bot: applied canary runtime change to serve-21 and serve-22.

ivy: monitoring canary nodes: p99 on canary nodes dropped to ~720ms. overall region still 1.2s because legacy nodes pending.

lucas: roll to rest of region excluding legacy nodes. watch queue_depth and p99.

ops-bot: rolled config to us-central-1 fleet (excluding legacy). region p99 dropped to ~780ms in 5m window. queue_depth normalized to 2-3.

emma: customer replied: improved, still sees intermittent spikes during bursts. wants permanent fix.

tom: follow-ups: - add per-model batching profile: smaller batch window for chat routes with expected long outputs - add dynamic-batching heuristic to reduce wait when token_count high or queue_depth>4 - add SLO guardrail: if p99 > SLO*1.4 for 3m, trigger auto-fallback + scale out - add perf-ci job that simulates 400+ token requests at 80-120r/s to detect tail regressions.

lucas: also consider token-length-based QoS: requests with expected output>300 tokens get lower batch wait and priority for early dispatch. Could add header `x-expected-output-tokens`.

emma: ops note: we should document exact runbook steps and decision criteria: when to canary config change vs rollback scheduler. include PromQL snippets and ri-opsctl commands.

ops-bot: suggestion: circuit-breaker config sample: `circuit_breaker: { p99_ms: 1000, window_s: 60, fallback: redwood-small-v2, action: route_to_fallback }`

ivy: making runbook edit: adding Playbook entry "Tail latency regression (chat routes)" with step-by-step. will link in incident INC-5510.

tom: I'll open a rollback run if region doesn't stabilize. keep customer comms updated.

rachel: customer updated: "latency better, thanks. we'll monitor and let you know if we see timeouts." I've scheduled a follow-up call.

lucas: postmortem owners: lucas + ivy. action items: perf-ci test (lucas), runtime flag `batch-window-dynamic` RFC (ivy), runbook commit (ivy), deployment policy update to avoid global adaptive-batching rollouts during high-load windows (tom).

emma: adding a short SLO proposal for chat routes in runbook: p95 goal 350ms, p99 goal 900ms. Emergency thresholds: p99>1500ms -> page oncall and auto-trigger fallback.

ops-bot: noteworthy: we've already added temporary token-based rate limiting for novam-prod: `rule: if expected_output>300 then rate=1r/s burst=4` applied.

rachel: final TL;DR to paste into post-incident notes: ```
TL;DR: p99 regression caused by scheduler v2.4.1 adaptive-batching increasing batch wait for throughput. Immediate mitigations: reduced batch-window for affected model/route in region, applied per-tenant concurrency cap, enabled route fallback to smaller model, and added token-length soft-rate-limit. Outcome: p99 reduced from ~1.6s -> ~780ms regionally; customer confirmed improvement. Follow-ups: perf-ci tests, per-model batching profiles, runtime dynamic batching flag, deployment policy changes, postmortem.```

ops-bot: monitoring snapshot at 09:40Z: p99(route:chat-complete,us-central-1)=768ms, p95=420ms.

ivy: I'll publish the runbook update and include example PromQL queries: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="chat-complete",region="us-central-1"}[2m])) by (le))` and queue depth: `sum(runtime_queue_depth{route="chat-complete",region="us-central-1"})`

tom: good work folks. leave incident open for 24h monitoring, then close as mitigated if stable.

emma: closing loop with customer: setting follow-up call and marking ticket "mitigated-pending-postmortem".

rachel: thanks everyone. adding runbook link to INC-5510 and assigning owners. :white_check_mark:
